newsitem.title: USA: American Radio buys two stations for $60 million.
newsitem.headline: American Radio buys two stations for $60 million.

text.p: American Radio Sytems Corp. said Thursday it acquired two radio stations in California from privately held Amaturo Group of California Ltd. for $60 million.
The stations are KFRG-FM in Riverside/San Bernadino and KXFG-FM in Sun City.
The deal is subject to regulatory approval.
Boston-based American Radio agreed to a $655 million merger with EZ Communications Inc. in August.
Its stock fell 37.5 cents to $31.25 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
